coordinate_frames.task_space: not provided; no task-space action may be inferred

data_format: LeRobot v3.0 Parquet plus H.264 MP4
known_limitations: Single desk, lighting setup, camera geometry and object collection.
Teleoperation quality and speed vary; task success and per-episode quality labels are absent.
Recovery behavior is incidental and uneven rather than deliberately scripted.
The source publishes only a train split; project splits must be frozen independently.
Camera intrinsics/extrinsics and a common task-space frame are not published.
native_action_semantics: Absolute calibrated SO-101 position command: five revolute joints in degrees and gripper in normalized 0..100 range.
redistribution_terms: Attribution and CC-BY-SA-4.0 share-alike apply to redistributed adaptations; preserve source attribution and license notices.
